unmeasured.intraday_path_historic: no minute/5-minute bars before the collector started (data/intraday keeps ~60 recent sessions of ~400 names)
unmeasured.time_of_high_low_historic: needs intraday bars; daily OHLC does not say which extreme came first
unmeasured.vwap_and_volume_profile: intraday volume by bar is only in data/intraday (recent, liquid names); no historic VWAP
unmeasured.pre_and_after_hours: no extended-hours bars are collected; the gap measure lumps the overnight move together
unmeasured.intraday_halts: halts inside a session are not recorded; only whole missing daily bars are seen
unmeasured.delisted_outcomes: the daily price panel is survivor-only: episodes of names that later delisted are missing (SURVIVOR_ONLY)
